headline: America's Largest Offshore Wind Farm Nears Completion
meta_description: America's largest offshore wind farm is 81% complete with all 176 foundations installed and power already flowing to Virginia's grid.
summary_short: All 176 foundations are in place at America's largest offshore wind farm, which is 81% complete and already supplying power to Virginia.
body:
America's largest offshore wind farm has reached a major milestone: all 176 foundations are now installed, with 31 turbines already operational and delivering power to Virginia's electrical grid since March 2026.

The project represents a significant leap forward in U.S. renewable energy infrastructure. With 81 percent of construction complete, the farm is on track to reach full capacity, which will mark a transformative moment for coastal power generation and the nation's clean energy transition.

As turbines continue to rise from the Atlantic seabed, each installation brings the project closer to its completion target. The power already flowing onshore demonstrates that the infrastructure works—proving offshore wind isn't a distant possibility but a present-day reality for American consumers.
quick_facts: 176 foundations fully installed at offshore wind site
Power flowing to Virginia's grid since March 2026
Clean energy now reaching homes and businesses
